About the job

1.) Introduction

Job Title: Organic Investor & Brand Growth Specialist
Work Hours/Schedule: Part-Time to start (around 20 hours per week) with a clear path to full-time. Flexible schedule, no fixed shift required, with a couple of hours of daily overlap with EST for calls and check-ins
Location: Fully Remote (open to Latin America, South Africa, and the Philippines)
Structure: Project-based ramp up. You start with a defined project and clear outcomes, then take on more scope as you prove results




2.) Overview

If you can turn a founder's raw thinking into content that makes serious investors reach out, this seat was built for you.




This is a small, founder-led U.S. based real estate investment firm operating on a private equity model. They raise capital from experienced professionals, senior executives, and business owners who partner with them on deals, typically wiring somewhere between fifty thousand and two hundred fifty thousand dollars per investment. The business is lean, transparent, and allergic to corporate theater. The founder says exactly what he means, expects the same in return, and measures work by whether it moves the number.




Right now the founder is doing most of this himself. He is writing the content, running the podcast, doing the outreach, and nurturing the pipeline. This role exists to take that entire engine off his plate and then make it better. You will own organic content across LinkedIn, YouTube, and podcasts, build the lead magnets and follow up sequences that warm prospective investors, and track what is actually converting so you can do more of it. The end goal is simple and easy to measure: more qualified investor calls booked.




3.) Key Responsibilities

Create and manage organic content across LinkedIn, YouTube, podcasts, and other social channels
Transform raw founder ideas into engaging written and video content designed to attract prospective investors
Refine content hooks, messaging, and structure to increase audience trust and inbound interest
Build and manage simple organic lead funnels, including lead magnets, automated messaging, and follow up sequences
Nurture prospective investors and move them from initial interest toward qualified booked calls
Track performance data to identify high converting content, optimize outreach efforts, and drive booked calls
Repurpose top performing content across multiple platforms to maximize reach and audience consistency
Own and continuously improve the brand growth process, proactively identifying new ways to generate qualified investor calls and contribute directly to revenue




4.) Must-Have Requirements

Proven experience managing organic content strategy and brand growth across major social platforms
Demonstrated ability to translate complex concepts into clear, engaging written and video content
Experience building organic lead funnels and nurture sequences that move prospects toward booked calls
Strong messaging skills with an understanding of content positioning and audience engagement
Ability to evaluate content performance data and proactively adapt strategy based on results
Strong ownership mindset, able to design their own workload around a stated outcome rather than waiting for instructions
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
Availability for part-time hours with a couple of hours of daily overlap with EST




5.) Nice-to-Have Requirements

Prior experience creating content tailored specifically to investor acquisition or finance audiences
Familiarity with video and podcast content editing workflows for multi-platform distribution
Track record of researching content trends and competitor strategies to unlock new growth opportunities
Comfort using AI tools to speed up repurposing and content production
Experience documenting processes and building SOPs others can follow




6.) Why Join Us

Most content roles bury you three layers below the person making decisions. This one puts you directly next to the founder, working on the single thing that grows the business. There is no committee, no brand deck to get approved, and no waiting two weeks for feedback. You bring an idea, you ship it, you see what it did.




The upside here is real. This is a lean team where every result is visible, which means the person who drives investor calls does not go unnoticed. The founder has been clear that he wants to grow this person, hand them more responsibility, and open up performance based upside for someone who genuinely moves the needle. You start with a defined project and a clear outcome, and the scope expands as fast as you can prove yourself. If you want a seat where your work is measured by results instead of hours logged, and where doing well actually changes your trajectory, this is it.

About the job

Paystand is the world's leading blockchain-enabled B2B payments network, transforming commercial finance into a software-driven, zero-fee, and open ecosystem. Recognized as a CNBC/Statista 2026 World's Top Fintech company, Paystand delivers over a decade of on-chain payments experience to middle and large enterprises.

Paystand's network services more than one million payors that have moved $20+ billion in volume. With its acquisitions of Yaydoo, Teampay and Bitwage, Paystand's full-stack platform includes agentic AI, its USDb stablecoin, and AR/AP solutions on one tightly integrated network. Its non-profit arm, Paystand.org, advances the mission to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain technology.

What We Do

We built the financial system we always thought should exist: zero fees, zero friction, just your money, faster. Blockchain automates receivables and payables, cuts time-to-cash, and turns every transaction into revenue instead of cost.

Why We Do It

The current system takes a cut from the people who build, create, and grow — and calls it the cost of doing business. We don't buy that. Every fee we eliminate compounds into growth. We're here to decentralize finance and hand the power back to the businesses driving the real economy — extended further through Paystand.org's work to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain.

How We Do It

We don't wait for permission or for the industry to catch up — we build the future of finance ourselves, on-chain, in the open. Small moves now, monumental results later.

Join Us

We're not looking for people who want a job in fintech. We're looking for people who want to build what comes after it. Paystand is where you help lead a financial revolution instead of just reading about one. We stand on change. Come stand with us.

Role at a Glance

As an Account Executive, this role owns the full sales cycle for Paystand's CFO stack, engaging CFOs, VPs of Finance, Controllers, and Treasury leaders at mid-size and enterprise companies. The role is responsible for creating and closing high-quality revenue opportunities by diagnosing finance pain, quantifying ROI, positioning automation value, and navigating complex buying processes.

This is a full-time, on-site position based in Roma Norte, Mexico City. The role is primarily conducted in Spanish, including day-to-day work and client interactions, but candidates must have advanced professional proficiency in English.

Responsibilities

The following are the primary responsibilities for this role. They may evolve as Paystand's sales strategy, AI-first operating model, and LatAm market priorities continue to mature.


Revenue Ownership & Full-Cycle Execution:
Own the full sales cycle for assigned opportunities, from prospecting and discovery through demo, proposal, negotiation, and close.
Manage inbound and outbound leads generated by SDRs, while proactively identifying and sourcing new business opportunities.
Build and maintain strong pipeline coverage through cold calls, email sequences, LinkedIn, Amplemarket, events, referrals, and targeted account-based outreach.


Consultative CFO-Level Selling:
Conduct high-quality discovery to understand finance pain points, ERP environment, cash flow needs, AR inefficiencies, decision criteria, and buying urgency before moving to demo.
Engage CFOs, VPs of Finance, Controllers, Treasury leaders, and executive stakeholders with strong business acumen and executive presence.
Travel to client sites across the region as needed for in-person demos, executive presentations, relationship building, and negotiation sessions.


Deal Strategy, Negotiation & Value Creation:
Develop tailored commercial proposals, quantify ROI, lead negotiations, and close deals with a focus on long-term customer value and quality revenue.
Continuously improve deal strategy using win/loss analysis, pipeline data, manager coaching, market feedback, and customer insights.
AI-Native Sales Execution:
Use AI tools actively for account research, outreach personalization, call preparation, call analysis, meeting summaries, proposal drafting, objection handling, and deal coaching.
Create reusable AI prompts, templates, talk tracks, and workflows that increase sales productivity while preserving message quality and accuracy.

Requirements

Ideal experience for this role can be gained through professional experience, sales performance, educational background, certifications, or relevant projects.

description:
About the job

Somos un grupo de medios digitales en crecimiento y buscamos a la persona que supervise nuestra operación de contenido asistida por inteligencia artificial. No vas a redactar notas: vas a revisarlas, aprobarlas y mejorar el sistema que las produce. Es un rol de criterio y de procesos, no de producción manual.




Es un puesto nuevo, con capacitación completa de nuestra parte. Buscamos a alguien de medios que quiera dar el salto a la operación editorial con IA, una de las habilidades más demandadas del sector.




QUÉ HARÁS EN TU DÍA A DÍA

• Revisar y aprobar contenido generado con herramientas de IA (notas informativas y videos) antes de su publicación, cuidando calidad, precisión y línea editorial.

• Detectar errores recurrentes y corregirlos en la fuente: mejorar las instrucciones y guías editoriales que alimentan al sistema, no corregir a mano nota por nota.

• Coordinar la publicación de contenido en varios sitios de noticias y sus redes sociales.

• Monitorear el desempeño orgánico de las páginas de Facebook (horarios, formatos, alcance) y proponer ajustes.

• Documentar procesos y participar en la retroalimentación semanal con la dirección.




REQUISITOS

• Licenciatura en Comunicación, Periodismo o experiencia equivalente en medios.

• 2 a 4 años de experiencia en medios digitales (redacción web, edición o coordinación de contenidos).

• Redacción y ortografía impecables, y criterio editorial sólido: saber qué se puede afirmar y qué no en temas judiciales, políticos y delicados.

• Curiosidad tecnológica real y disposición a trabajar todos los días con herramientas de IA (te capacitamos, pero las ganas las traes tú).

• Organización, autonomía y discreción absoluta. Se firma acuerdo de confidencialidad.




NO NECESITAS

• Saber programar. Ninguna parte del puesto requiere código.

• Experiencia previa con IA. Requiere criterio de editor; la herramienta se aprende aquí.




OFRECEMOS

• Sueldo de $18,000 a $20,000 brutos mensuales según experiencia, con esquema de crecimiento a los 6 meses.

• Bonos por desempeño.

• Horario flexible: el puesto se mide por resultados, no por horas frente al escritorio.

• Modalidad híbrida o 100% remota, según tu ubicación y preferencia.

• Prestaciones de ley.

• Capacitación directa en operación editorial con IA, con proyectos reales desde la primera semana.




CÓMO APLICAR

Envía tu CV y portafolio (links de páginas, cuentas o medios que hayas manejado, con tu rol y periodo) a talento@emasmedios.com con el asunto "Editor Operaciones IA". Te responderemos con dos ejercicios cortos de criterio editorial y creatividad; solo avanzan quienes los completan.
